plugins.name: TB Resonator
plugins.description: Tunable modal resonator for pitched, playable textures.

notesKo: A 0.1 Hz–5 kHz internal carrier covers everything from tremolo to metallic sidebands.
Includes Sine–Triangle–Square waveform morphing, Wet Tone, and six Factory presets.

portfolio.descriptionKo: 내부 캐리어로 트레몰로부터 금속성 사이드밴드까지 만드는 링 모듈레이터입니다.

plugins.name: TB Ring Modulation
plugins.description: Internal-carrier ring modulation from tremolo to metallic sidebands.

notesKo: Safely records the unaltered Mono/Stereo signal at the DAW insert point.
Supports WAV, FLAC, AIFF, MP3, AAC, and OGG conversion plus automatic time-based splitting.

portfolio.descriptionKo: DAW 인서트 신호를 기록하고 선택한 포맷과 시간 길이로 자동 변환·분할하는 레코더입니다.

plugins.name: TB Recorder
plugins.description: Insert-point recorder with automatic format conversion and splitting.

notesKo: Combines octave-up granular voices with an early diffuser and eight-line FDN tail for crystalline spatial effects.
Adds Level Var, Position Rand, Pitch Spray, 100 Factory presets, and versioned preset/state migration.

portfolio.descriptionKo: 옥타브 업 그레인과 확산형 잔향을 겹쳐 반짝이는 쉬머·크리스털 공간감을 만듭니다.

plugins.name: TB Shimmer
plugins.description: Granular shimmer with crystalline pitch feedback and diffuse swarm tails.

notesKo: Added a compact 590x450 interface with an accessible Factory preset selector.
Introduced 30 categorized Factory presets with host-notified parameter changes, edited-state tracking, and recall.
Kept all five public parameters and the host program count unchanged for project compatibility.

portfolio.descriptionKo: 고역의 선명도와 배음을 더해 믹스의 밝기와 존재감을 자연스럽게 강화합니다.

plugins.name: TB Exciter
plugins.description: Harmonic exciter and enhancer with 30 Factory presets.

notesKo: Introduced a tape-style varispeed motor with independent 0–2 second stop and start times.
Added freehand and point-based motor curves, six curve shortcuts, eight Factory presets, and latency-aligned bypass.
Adopted a compact 498x260 reel-deck interface with live tape-motion feedback.

portfolio.descriptionKo: 자유 드로잉 모터 커브와 독립적인 정지·시작 시간으로 오디오를 테이프처럼 감속해 완전히 멈추고 다시 정상 속도로 재가속합니다.

plugins.name: TB Tape
plugins.description: A custom-curve tape-motor effect that slows audio to silence and accelerates it back to speed.

notesKo: Introduced level-independent, language-neutral sibilance detection with stereo-linked spectral reduction.
Added Focus and Tame controls, Wide/Split processing, Listen, bypass, and honest gain-reduction and detector-confidence metering.
Validated the Windows VST3 with automated DSP, A/B, UI, and host-contract gates; manual DAW, listening, performance, packaging, and rights checks remain deferred.

portfolio.descriptionKo: 입력 레벨과 언어에 덜 의존하는 검출과 스테레오 연동 스펙트럴 감쇄로, 보컬의 공기감과 딕션은 유지하면서 거친 치찰음을 줄이는 디에서입니다.

plugins.name: TB De-Esser
plugins.description: A level-independent, language-neutral de-esser that uses stereo-linked spectral reduction to tame harsh sibilance while preserving vocal air and diction.

notesKo: Introduced 120 factory tables with 2–256 keyframes for morphable spectral filtering.
Added four phase modes, bounded spectral contours, nonlinear drive, and a Frame LFO.
Passed automated DSP, audio, UI, host-contract, and isolated benchmark gates; manual DAW, listening, signing, and rights checks remain deferred.

portfolio.descriptionKo: 최대 256프레임 웨이브테이블의 배음 윤곽을 필터 응답으로 바꾸고 Frame LFO와 네 가지 위상 모드로 움직이는 스펙트럴 필터입니다.

plugins.name: TB Filter Table
plugins.description: A wavetable-derived spectral filter that morphs up to 256 frames into moving response contours with four phase modes, nonlinear drive, and a frame LFO.

notesKo: Introduced a 2048-point STFT grain field that moves a dense spectral notch grid with controlled stereo orbit.
Added Grain, Move, Width, Amount, and Mix controls with 11 factory presets.
Passed all 123 DSP checks, 12-pair A/B rendering, UI, and repeatable host-contract gates; manual DAW, listening, signing, and rights checks remain deferred.

portfolio.descriptionKo: 촘촘한 FFT 노치 그리드와 스테레오 모션으로 패드·기타·드럼을 입자처럼 잘게 조각하는 스펙트럴 페이저입니다.

plugins.name: TB Grain Phaser
plugins.description: A spectral phaser that moves a dense FFT notch grid with controlled stereo orbit to carve pads, guitars, and drums into grain-like texture.

notesKo: Reversed the response graph hierarchy so Range now reads as the shaded base envelope and the live gain reduction rides on top as the overlay.
Tinted the live overlay with the selected band colour and thinned the Range contour to a single-pixel lid over a filled area.
Stopped both contours from drawing where they sit at 0 dB, so the shared datum line is no longer painted over.

portfolio.descriptionKo: 필요한 주파수에 최대 네 개 자유 밴드를 배치해 밴드별 압축·확장, 사이드체인, M/S 처리와 signed Range를 제어하는 멀티밴드 다이내믹스입니다.

plugins.name: TB Multiband Compressor
plugins.description: A four-band free-placement dynamics processor with per-band compression or expansion, sidechain, stereo/Mid/Side targeting, signed Range, and Dynamic or Linear modes.
